information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

IS : 11026-1984 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RAZOR HONE 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dirrensions and other requirements for razor hones, usually used by barbers 
for sharpening razors. 



2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Fig. 1. 

WOODEN BASE 

HONE 




2Stt 






^r^ 






*50i2 ■ 



3> Material 

3.1 Abrasive 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS OF RAZOR HONE 



Emery with a minimum of 60 percent aluminium oxide. 



3.2 Bond— Any suitable bonding material which when mixed with the abrasive in suitable proportion 
and made into shape shall withstand the requirements laid down in 6.1, 6.2 and 6.4, 

3.3 Base for Housing the Hones — Shall be made of seasoned wood. 

4. Manufacture — The hones shall be manufactured from the materials specified in 3.1 and 3.2, and 
shall be capable of continuously exposing the cutting abrasive surface while sharpening the razors. 
They shall have no tendency of glazing whatsoever. 

4.1 The hones shall be housed in the wooden base in such a manner that it does not have any 
movement while sharpening the razors. 

5. Workmanship and Finish — Hone shall be uniform in texture, sound, free from cracks and pits or 
any other imperfection and shall be finished smooth with the faces and edges straight and true. The 
wooden base shall be given suitable varnish coating. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Resistance to Heat — Hone, when exposed by placing on a flat surface to a temperature 
of 60 ± 1X in air circulating oven for 4 hours, shall not show any signs of softening, deformation or 
any other defects, which shall impair its serviceability or appearance. 

6.2 Resistance to Cold ( at Subzero Temperature ) — Hones, when exposed by placing on a flat surface 
to a temperature of ± 2°C in a freezer for 4 hours; shall not show any signs of cracking or any other 
defects, which shall impair its serviceability or appearance. 

6.3 Aluminium Oxide Content ~ Shall be determined as given in 4.1 of IS : 3178-1965 'Specification 
for abrasives emery grain' after removing the bonding material. 

6.4 Performance — Hones shall be capable of giving a sharp and keen edge to the razor, conforming to 
IS : 888-1965 'Specification for hollow ground razors, open type ( revised)', The razor thus sharpened 
shall be capable of giving minimum of six smooth shaves of both soft and hard types each. 

Note 1 — Before the razor is sharpened on the hone, the surface of the hone shall be cleaned with water to 
remove all traces of extraneous matters. 

Note 2 — The razor after being sharpened on the hone may be strapped on a leather strip for lapping to 
remove any signs of burrs^ during every shave. 



Adopted 29 August 1984 



O December 1984, IS) 



Gr 1 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG

18:11026-1984 

7. Packing — Each hone shall be packed in a cardboard carton and 35 such cartons shall be packed 
in a plywood packing case conforming to IS : 2674-1980 'Specification for plywood cases — battened 
construction ( first revision )' lined with waterproof paper. 

8. Marking 

8.1 Hones shall be stamped with manufacturer's name or trade-mark and the year of manufacture. 
8.1.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

9. Sampling 

9.1 Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller the sampling inspection shall be 
carried out according to the procedure given in IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables. 
Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count of defects ( first revision )'. The inspection level and AQL 
value for various characteristics shall be as given in 9,1.1 and 9.1-2 respectively. 

9.1.1 For inspection of dimensions, workmanship and finish, a single sampling plan with Inspection 
level 111 and AQL 4 percent as given in Table 1 and Table 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973, shall be 
followed. 

9.1.2 For various tests given under 6, a single sampling plan with inspection level I and AQL 1 percent 
as given in Table 1 and Table 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973, shall be followed. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the 
specification for Hones Razor IND/GS/1243 issued by the Controllerate of Inspection General Stores, 
Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
